title: Simon 7.3.3(2), (11)–(12): flatness at arbitrarily small scales outside a set F with μH[n−2+α](F) = 0
statement: For all n, k, ℓ ∈ ℕ with ℓ ≤ k and n ≥ 1, all sets U, N ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} and every T ∈ 𝒟_n(U): if U is open, N is an embedded C² (n+ℓ)-dimensional submanifold (IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N), (closure N ∖ N) ∩ U = ∅, T is minimizing in U ∩ N (IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N)), spt T ⊆ U ∩ N and ∂T = 0 in U (BoundaryVanishes T), then there is a set F ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} with μH[n − 2 + α](F) = 0 for every real α > 0 such that every x ∈ spt T ∖ F is flat at arbitrarily small scales: for every β > 0 and every R > 0 there are ρ with 0 < ρ < R and an n-dimensional linear subspace Q ⊆ ℝ^{n+k} such that |(y − x) − p_Q(y − x)| < βρ for every y ∈ spt T with |y − x| < ρ (p_Q the orthogonal projection onto Q, Lean `Q.starProjection`).
lean_statement: ∀ (n k ℓ : ℕ), ℓ ≤ k → ∀ (U N : Set (Euclid (n + k))) (T : GeometricCurrentOn U n), 1 ≤ n → IsOpen U → IsEmbeddedSubmanifold 2 (n + ℓ) N → (closure N \ N) ∩ U = ∅ → IsMinimizingIn T (U ∩ N) → T.support ⊆ U ∩ N → BoundaryVanishes T → ∃ F : Set (Euclid (n + k)), (∀ α : ℝ, 0 < α → μH[(n : ℝ) - 2 + α] F = 0) ∧ ∀ x ∈ T.support \ F, ∀ β : ℝ, 0 < β → ∀ R : ℝ, 0 < R → ∃ ρ : ℝ, 0 < ρ ∧ ρ < R ∧ ∃ Q : Submodule ℝ (Euclid (n + k)), Module.finrank ℝ Q = n ∧ ∀ y ∈ T.support, dist y x < ρ → ‖(y - x) - Q.starProjection (y - x)‖ < β * ρ
